scope: Release macOS app with bundled 1,705 venues and isolated storage; RSS sampled once per second after direct launch. Attached Time Profiler starts after launch, so no cold-launch latency or GPU/FPS claim.
limitations: One short idle discovery run with MapKit and Instruments attached. Startup RSS includes an early pre-initialization sample. No repeated pan/zoom, retained allocation analysis, peak guarantee, cold-launch latency, GPU/FPS, or physical-device measurement.
